67:1.text: Blessed be He in Whose Hand is the dominion; and He is Able to do all things.

67:2.text: Who has created death and life that He may test you which of you is best in deed.
And He is the All-Mighty, the Oft-Forgiving;

67:3.text: Who has created the seven heavens one above another; you can see no fault in the creation of the Most Gracious. Then look again: "Can you see any rifts?"

67:4.text: Then look again and yet again: your sight will return to you in a state of humiliation and worn out.

67:5.text: And indeed We have adorned the nearest heaven with lamps
, and We have made such lamps
missiles to drive away the Shayâtîn
, and have prepared for them the torment of the blazing Fire.

67:6.text: And for those who disbelieve in their Lord
is the torment of Hell, and worst indeed is that destination.

67:7.text: When they are cast therein, they will hear the
drawing in of its breath as it blazes forth.

67:8.text: It almost bursts up with fury. Every time a group is cast therein, its keeper will ask: "Did no warner come to you?"

67:9.text: They will say: "Yes, indeed a warner did come to us, but we belied him and said: ‘Allâh never sent down anything
; you are only in great error.’"

67:10.text: And they will say: "Had we but listened or used our intelligence, we would not have been among the dwellers of the blazing Fire!"

67:11.text: Then they will confess their sin. So, away with the dwellers of the blazing Fire!

67:12.text: Verily,, those who fear their Lord unseen
(i.e. they do not see Him, nor His punishment in the Hereafter)
, theirs will be forgiveness and a great reward
